notes:
{貧|まず}しい is an i-adjective describing poverty or insufficiency.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {貧|まず}しく
- Noun form: {貧|まず}しさ (poverty, poorness)

TWO MEANINGS:
1. Financially poor: {貧|まず}しい{家庭|かてい} (poor family)
2. Lacking quality: {発想|はっそう}が{貧|まず}しい (lacking imagination)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {貧|まず}しい{生活|せいかつ}: impoverished life
- {貧|まず}しい{国|くに}: poor country
- {心|こころ}が{貧|まず}しい: spiritually poor/petty

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {貧乏|びんぼう}: poor (noun/na-adjective, more colloquial)
- {貧困|ひんこん}: poverty (formal noun)

OPPOSITE:
- {裕福|ゆうふく}: wealthy
- {金持|かねも}ち: rich person
